mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned underground gold-silver project, Malheur County, Oregon (held via Calico Resources USA Corp.). Updated FS announced May 28, 2026 (post-dates FY2025; cited as most current): P&P reserves 405,000 oz Au; M+I resources 1.36 Moz Au (inclusive of reserves); avg annual production 41,400 oz Au + 51,500 oz Ag over 9.3-yr life at avg head grade 0.18 oz/t Au (6.06 g/t), 93% recovery; initial capex $189.8M, sustaining $65.1M; AISC $1,442/oz Au (net of Ag credits at $48/oz); after-tax NPV5% $374.7M, IRR 38.9%, payback 2.2 yr (base case); upside case at $4,618/oz Au: NPV5% $608.6M, IRR 55.4%, payback 1.4 yr. Permitting in progress; no production. Cryla claims (589 acres W of site) under lease; Frost Project (40 claims, 12 mi W) 100% owned, no known reserves.

100%-owned Sleeper Gold Project, Humboldt County, Nevada. Historic Amax open-pit mine produced 1.66 Moz Au and 2.3 Moz Ag (1986-1996); facilities removed. Exploration stage since Paramount's 2010 acquisition; no reserves; feasibility study not yet completed. Royalties: Snyder Syndicate 1% NSR; Franco-Nevada 2% NSR (2,474 claims); Evolving Gold 2%; ICN 0.5-1.5%; Sprott Deeds of Trust securing debenture.

notes: Ticker PZG on NYSE American. FY2025 = year ended June 30, 2025 (10-K filed per stocktitan Aug 2026). No production, no revenue. FY2025 net loss $9.05M (up ~12% YoY); loss per share $0.13. Exploration/development spend $2.60M; land holding costs $743K; corporate $3.18M; interest expense $1.69M. CEO Rachel Goldman. FY2025 10-K confirms Grassy Mountain has P&P reserves but does not restate tonnage; reserve tonnage/grade omitted here pending the 2026 FS technical report. Frost claims and Cryla claims have no known reserves.
